subject: Security intake & MAP: SOC 2 / SIG-CAIQ / DPA + retention options
messages:
From: Emma Wright <emma.wright@lumenbank.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com
Cc: legal@lumenbank.com, security@lumenbank.com
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 15:37:00 -0700
Subject: Security intake & MAP for LumenBank evaluation

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. LumenBank would like to formalize an evaluation MAP so our security and legal teams can review acceptance criteria and evidence timelines. High-level asks from our side:
- SOC 2 status and expected timeline to produce the report (if available)
- A completed SIG/CAIQ or our questionnaire pre-filled where possible
- Your standard DPA (we'll share redlines) and a proposed retention/archival table for PII and logs
- Evidence owners and a realistic window to hand over artifacts during the POC (we prefer a 3-week evidence sprint if feasible)

I've attached our SIG-CAIQ spreadsheet and the intake checklist. Can you confirm who on your side will own each gate and whether Redwood can commit to a target close-date for the MAP (we're aiming to make a go/no-go decision by the end of September).

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Wright
Head of Security Programs, LumenBank
attachments: LumenBank_SIG-CAIQ.xlsx, LumenBank_Intake_Checklist.pdf

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Wright <emma.wright@lumenbank.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com, neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security intake & MAP for LumenBank evaluation

Hi Emma — great to meet you all. Attaching a compact MAP and our standard evidence inventory to get alignment. Summary below and proposed timeline so you can take back to procurement/legal/security: 

MAP skeleton (high level)
- Week 0 (this week): Intake meeting + handoff of SIG-CAIQ (you provided) and any clarification questions.
- Week 1: Redwood provides: SOC 2 status memo + SOC 2 control mappings (if report available we can share under NDA), completed portions of SIG/CAIQ, and a DPA draft for redline.
- Week 2: Evidence sprint window (3 business days of active submissions from Redwood owners + 1 week buffer for follow-ups).
- Week 3: Final acceptance checklist and closure call; decision by LumenBank.

Gate owners (proposed)
- SOC 2 / controls memo: privacy & compliance (soojin_lee) + engineering (jonas_weber)
- SIG / CAIQ completions: solutions (ben_carter) + security (soojin_lee)
- DPA and legal terms: legal (neha_kapoor) — we will accept DocuSign signing + tracked redline process

Key acceptance criteria (examples)
- SOC 2: Either current Type II report shared under NDA OR a controls mapping + remediation plan for any gaps that materially affect data residency/availability/security within 14 days.
- SIG/CAIQ: No high-risk items left unmitigated; any medium items must have documented compensating controls and timeline.
- DPA: Standard Redwood template with carveouts limited to customer-requested data residency; we can accept a single round of non-material redlines and then escalate.

Data retention options (proposed)
- Default: 90 days for request/response payloads (unredacted)
- PII minimal: 30 days unless customer elects longer archival (30/90/365 options)
- Audit logs / trace: 365 days by default; we can offer shorter windows for EU customers by config

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2-summary.pdf (control map), RWI-DPA-redline-v1.docx (placeholder draft)

Next steps: Can we lock an intake call Friday 09/03 10:00–11:00 PT? Also — any specific evidence items you need first (e.g., vulnerability scan results, pen test report, KMS configuration)?

Best,
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0199
attachments: Redwood_SOC2-summary.pdf, RWI-DPA-redline-v1.docx

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Wright <emma.wright@lumenbank.com>, soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security intake & MAP for LumenBank evaluation

Hi Emma / team — looping in Legal. Quick notes on the DPA / retention track so expectations are clear: 
- We'll push the draft DPA into DocuSign (link below) for a controlled redline and review cycle; target turnaround for the first redline is 5 business days.
- For retention, we typically propose configuration choices at onboarding: 30 / 90 / 365 day presets. If LumenBank needs longer archival for regulatory reasons we can add a schedule with pricing impacts (we'll include a table in the MAP).
- Regarding evidence transfer: Redwood will provide artifacts via a shared Drive folder and an evidence index CSV. For sensitive artifacts we can grant time-limited viewer access; we do not ship raw backups.

Open questions for your legal/security teams
- Is LumenBank ok with evidence access via shared Drive and temporary access tokens, or do you require SFTP with a formal transfer?
- For SOC 2 sharing, do you prefer a limited-scope NDA (we can provide) or an MSA addendum?

DocuSign (DPA draft): https://www.docusign.com/en/link/rwi-dpa-2347
Shared evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-LumenBank-evidence

If Friday's intake works for everyone I'll organize the calendar invite and owners.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
attachments: none

From: Emma Wright <emma.wright@lumenbank.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com
Cc: legal@lumenbank.com, security@lumenbank.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security intake & MAP for LumenBank evaluation

Thanks Soojin and Neha — Friday 09/03 10:00 PT works for the intake. A few clarifications before the call: 
- We prefer Drive for initial evidence access (time-limited viewer is OK).
- Please include your pen-test summary and any third-party vendor attestations in the evidence index; we'll need the scope dates.
- For data retention, LumenBank would prefer 365 for logs and 90 for request payloads as a starting point — please flag any operational or cost constraints during the call.

We'll bring our security intake lead (security@lumenbank.com) and legal ops. Looking forward to the call and reviewing the MAP. If you can push the DPA draft into DocuSign prior to the call that will speed things up.

Best,
Emma
attachments: none
